description:
Job Title: Billing & Authorization Manager
Location: South Africa
Job Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: US Hours (9am-5pm EST)

We are seeking a highly detail-oriented and organised Billing & Authorizations Specialist to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring that billing codes, insurance authorizations, and supporting documentation are accurate, compliant, up to date, and correctly entered into the relevant EMR and billing systems.
This role requires strong knowledge of medical billing, insurance authorization processes, CPT codes, and payer requirements. Experience within pediatric healthcare, pediatric therapy, Early Intervention, behavioral health, or a similar healthcare environment would be highly advantageous.
The Billing & Authorizations Specialist will work closely with therapists, clinicians, providers, and insurance companies to ensure that services are appropriately authorised and billed and that any discrepancies are resolved efficiently.
Key Responsibilities

• Review billing codes and insurance authorizations to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance.

• Ensure all required authorizations are obtained before services are billed.

• Monitor authorizations to ensure they remain current and proactively manage upcoming expirations or required extensions.

• Accurately enter and maintain authorization and billing information within the EMR and billing system.

• Verify that services are billed only when valid and appropriate insurance authorizations are in place.

• Follow up proactively with therapists, clinicians, and providers when required documentation, treatment information, or authorizations are missing.

• Communicate directly with insurance companies regarding authorization status, extensions, denials, payer requirements, and billing-related inquiries.

• Investigate and resolve billing discrepancies and authorization issues in a timely manner.

• Maintain accurate and well-organised records of authorizations, billing information, and related communications.

• Ensure all processes are completed in accordance with relevant payer requirements and company procedures.

• Work within an EMR and/or billing software platform commonly used by Early Intervention or pediatric healthcare providers.

• Identify potential authorization or billing issues before they impact service delivery or reimbursement.

• Collaborate with internal teams to ensure smooth communication and efficient resolution of outstanding matters.

Requirements

• Previous experience in medical billing and insurance authorizations.

• Strong understanding of CPT codes, medical billing processes, and payer requirements.

• Experience managing insurance authorizations, including obtaining, updating, extending, and resolving denied or missing authorizations.

• Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.

• Strong organisational and administrative skills.

• Ability to manage multiple authorizations, deadlines, and follow-ups simultaneously.

• Comfortable communicating professionally with therapists, clinicians, healthcare providers, and insurance companies.

• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to investigate and resolve discrepancies independently.

• Experience working with EMR and/or medical billing software.

title: Strategic Finance Lead
description:
About Plooto

Plooto is a Canada-born fintech company on a mission to give small and mid-sized businesses the financial power to succeed on their own terms. We make payments secure, accurate, and stress-free so businesses and their accountants can spend less time in the books, confidently manage cash flow, and make smarter decisions every day. We're a team that builds with integrity, agility, and heart, and we're looking for customer-minded pros who share our passion to join us as we scale.
About the Role
We’re hiring a Strategic Finance Lead to embed with the teams that drive our business - GTM, Product, and others as we grow - and raise the quality of decisions across the company. This is a partnering seat, not a reporting one: you’ll be in the room when a decision is being framed, not summarizing it afterward.
You’ll own the financial models for the areas you support, end to end. Because you own them, you’re in the decision rather than downstream of it. When a metric moves, your job isn’t to report that it moved - it’s to explain why, say whether that’s good or bad, and recommend what to do about it. When your business partners are weighing a decision, you’re the person quantifying the return.
You won’t inherit a playbook. You’ll write one - defining how finance partners with the business as the function grows.
The bar we’re setting
Today, a conversation about CAC often ends at “CAC went to $X because spend changed.” That’s arithmetic. We want a partner who asks the next questions: why did spend move - was it a deliberate test? What was the hypothesis, and how did it perform? How do we know our experiments are working? Is this a healthy shift or an early warning?
That’s the difference between reporting numbers and driving decisions, and it’s the heart of this role. We have good visibility into top-line trends; what we want is the ability to go a level deeper, consistently. That takes persistence - following the signal and going to find the data rather than waiting for it.
What you’ll cover
Today this role partners most closely with GTM - subscriber forecasting - and Product, where you’ll forecast TPV and revenue by product line and payment rail. As we grow, that will likely extend to Payments Strategy, Risk, and Operations.
We’ll be straight with you: we haven’t fully defined what finance support for those teams looks like yet, and we don’t expect one person to cover everything at once. Part of this job is helping us decide where finance partnership earns the most - and saying so when something should wait.
Your models serve two audiences: the teams they’re built for, and the company plan they roll into. We want models shaped to how each part of the business actually works that still connect cleanly to the central budget - so we plan from one picture instead of reconciling siloed models before a board meeting.
Build the system, not just the model
We’re not planning to solve capacity by adding people. We’d rather solve it with infrastructure: SQL pulling live from Databricks into models that refresh themselves, analysis that’s reproducible instead of rebuilt each month, and AI in the workflow where it genuinely saves time. You should be the kind of person who, faced with a manual process, gets slightly irritated and fixes it.
Much of our forecasting runs on Excel today, supported by live pipelines from our data warehouse. We know we’ll need something more scalable - and we’re deliberately open about what that is, whether a dedicated FP&A tool, a rebuild that leans harder on automation, or a different architecture altogether. You’ll help us decide and build it.
The team, and where this goes
Strategic finance is three people: the Senior Director (your manager), a Senior Financial Analyst, and you. The analyst owns the core FP&A engine - the company model, actuals, month-end performance analysis, and investor reporting. You’ll own the function-level models that feed it. title: Dedicated Support Engineer - London
description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s User Operations team shepherds our customers’ adoption of AI and ensures that our customers' product experience is nothing short of exceptional. We are building the very first post-AGI support team. We resolve complex issues, provide technical guidance, and support customers in maximizing value and adoption from deploying our products. We work closely with Sales, Technical Success, Product, Engineering and others, to deliver the best possible experience to our customers at scale. OpenAI's customers represent a range of diverse backgrounds and maturity, from early-stage startups to established global enterprises.

About the Role

The Support Engineering team works closely with Engineering, Product, Technical Success, Go-to-Market, and other teams to deliver an exceptional experience for our most strategic customers. We combine deep technical troubleshooting with durable customer context, proactive reliability work, and clear ownership during critical moments. We use automation, agents, and our own technology to help build the future of technical support.

We’re looking for experienced, deeply curious technical problem-solvers to serve as trusted support partners for our Premium Support customers. You’ll work directly with customers on novel, ambiguous, and high-impact technical issues, using logs, telemetry, reproduction, and systems-level investigation to isolate causes and drive issues toward resolution.

Beyond resolving individual issues, you’ll use your deep understanding of OpenAI’s infrastructure and products, together with each customer’s architecture and operating context, to anticipate risk and make their workloads more resilient over time. You’ll proactively monitor integrations, identify emerging failure patterns and architectural breakpoints, and work with customers and internal teams to address them before they become incidents. Success means that as a customer’s workloads mature and scale, the day-to-day effort required to support them decreases through better monitoring, runbooks, automation, and preventative improvements.

In this role, you will:

- Work directly with Premium Support customers to troubleshoot their most complex technical issues, including API failures, integration challenges, authentication errors, unexpected product behavior, performance degradation, and production incidents.

- Provide end-to-end technical ownership by analyzing logs and system behavior, reproducing errors, testing hypotheses, and isolating the likely failure domain. Where possible, you’ll identify the root cause before escalating to Engineering; where that is not possible, you’ll provide a clear hypothesis and the evidence needed to accelerate Engineering’s investigation.

As a Staff AI Security Architect at Datavant , you will lead the design, evolution, and adoption of secure by design principles across our AI and Machine Learning (ML) systems. This role sits at the intersection of AI innovation and security architecture. You will define and operationalize AI security strategy, embed security into the AI/ML development lifecycle, and partner deeply with data science, engineering, product, legal, and compliance teams to ensure our AI systems are secure, trustworthy, and scalable.

title: Chief of Staff to the CEO (m/f/d)
description:
ÜBER BUENA

Buena macht alles rund um Immobilien so einfach und transparent wie den Kauf eines ETFs - von der Suche und Finanzierung bis zum Kauf und zur Verwaltung. Dafür übernehmen wir Hausverwaltungen in ganz Deutschland und entwickeln sie mit eigener Software, besseren Prozessen und starken Teams weiter.

Unterstützt von GV arbeiten wir daran, mehr Menschen den Zugang zu Wohneigentum und damit zum Vermögensaufbau zu ermöglichen.

ÜBER DIE ROLLE

Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem CEO an den wichtigsten Herausforderungen von Buena.

Dein Aufgabenbereich wächst mit Buena. Du solltest Freude daran haben, dich schnell in unbekannte Themen einzuarbeiten, dir eine eigene Meinung zu bilden und Verantwortung zu übernehmen, bevor dir jemand einen detaillierten Auftrag gibt.

DEINE VERANTWORTLICHKEITEN

- Projekte, die Buena voranbringen. Du übernimmst wichtige Aufgaben in Operations und Product. Du definierst das Ziel, bringst die richtigen Menschen zusammen und steuerst die Umsetzung.

- Fundierte Entscheidungen. Du prüfst neue Möglichkeiten, analysierst Zahlen und sprichst mit den Menschen, die das Problem aus erster Hand kennen. Daraus entwickelst du klare Empfehlungen für den CEO.

- Konsequente Umsetzung. Du übersetzt Entscheidungen in klare Verantwortlichkeiten, Termine und nächste Schritte. Hindernisse erkennst du früh und räumst sie gemeinsam mit den Teams aus dem Weg.

- Klare Kommunikation. Du bereitest Unternehmensupdates, Gespräche im Führungsteam und Investorenunterlagen mit vor. Komplexe Themen bringst du verständlich auf den Punkt

DU PASST ZU DIESER BESONDEREN ROLLE, WENN DU

- Schon früh außergewöhnliche Ergebnisse erzielt hast. Du hast bereits Verantwortung übernommen, die deutlich über das für deine Erfahrung übliche Maß hinausgeht. Deinen persönlichen Beitrag kannst du an konkreten Ergebnissen zeigen.

- Extreme Eigeninitiative mitbringst. Du wartest weder auf einen Auftrag noch auf eine Anleitung. Wenn du ein Problem erkennst, findest du heraus, was nötig ist, und bringst die Lösung selbst ins Rollen.

- Dich durchbeißt. Eine ausbleibende Antwort, ein erstes Nein oder ein „Das geht bei uns nicht“ ist für dich kein Endpunkt. Du fasst nach, verstehst die Einwände, findest andere Zugänge und gewinnst die richtigen Menschen für die Lösung.

- Verantwortung am Ergebnis misst. Eine verschickte E-Mail ist für dich noch keine erledigte Aufgabe. Du bleibst dran, bis das Problem gelöst ist, und übernimmst Verantwortung dafür, dass aus Zusagen Ergebnisse werden.

En Flix encontraras equipos que se unen para superar desafíos y fomentar la creatividad. Si estás listo para crecer y liderar tu propio camino, ¡Flix es el lugar para ti!

We are seeking an experienced, strategic, and highly analytical leader to elevate our category insight capabilities. More than one million developers, from indie researchers to teams running frontier models in production, use Runpod to experiment, train, fine-tune, deploy, and scale AI on one platform. The platform has processed more than 20 billion inference requests. We closed a $100M Series A in June 2026. We're at an inflection point for AI infrastructure, and we're building the platform the next generation of developers will depend on. Learn more in our CEO's funding announcement: https://www.runpod.io/blog/one-million-developers.

We're a small, remote-first team. We take ownership seriously, move fast, and ship work that more than a million developers rely on every day. We're looking for people who care deeply, build with urgency, and want to matter at scale.

The Affiliate & Creator Marketing Lead joins Runpod's Marketing team, a lean, high-output team responsible for how Runpod shows up across every channel developers and infrastructure buyers touch. This role reports to the Director of Growth & Demand Gen and works closely with Growth, Content, Product Marketing, PR/Comms, DevRel, and Sales. Affiliate is already one of Runpod's most productive acquisition channels. It has historically been supported by agency partners (Advertise Purple, FNF), both of which are winding down as this hire brings affiliate and creator management fully in-house; PartnerStack remains our platform of record. A separate influencer motion has run out of PR/Comms as one-off creator activations (sponsored newsletters, YouTube drops) measured on impressions and clicks; that motion is now being folded under Demand Gen, with the mandate to shift it from an awareness metric to a signups-and-revenue one.

We're looking for a hands-on Affiliate & Creator Marketing Lead to own and scale Runpod's affiliate program while completing the consolidation of our influencer and creator relationships into that same motion. This is a mid-senior role for someone who thrives on relationship-building, incentive design, and finding the next great creator to partner with before anyone else does. You'll grow the affiliate program's reach, deepen relationships with existing affiliates, scout and sign new creators across the internet, fold the right ones into the affiliate program with properly structured incentives, and turn one-off sponsored placements into an ongoing, performance-based partnership. You'll also partner with DevRel on community and creator discovery, and support Product Marketing in extending the reach of the executive team's personal accounts.

You're inheriting two programs with real traction, not a blank page: the affiliate program already drives meaningful signups and revenue every week, and the influencer program has already landed real creators and real impressions. What's missing is the connective tissue: a single motion where creators are incentivized on signups and revenue instead of one-off sponsorship fees, where the best affiliates and the best creators are treated as the same kind of partner, and where finding the next great partner is a repeatable process instead of an ad hoc one. Get this right and it becomes one of Runpod's most efficient and most visible growth channels.

- Strengthen relationships with existing high-performing affiliates through proactive outreach, better communication, and improved support.

- Monitor affiliate performance and program health (signups, fraud signals, engagement) in PartnerStack, our platform of record, and partner with Marketing Ops to keep tracking and attribution accurate.

- Continuously test and refine commission structures, tiering, and incentives (challenges, competitions, utilization-based kickbacks) to maximize both signups and progra

Position Overview
Boyd Thermal is seeking a Vice President of Sales to lead the global commercial organization for its Coolant Distribution Unit business, a portfolio scaling past $1B in revenue next year. This executive owns the global revenue number: the sales strategy, the customer and channel architecture, the pricing discipline that protects gross margin, and the forecasting rigor a business of this growth rate demands. The role spans hyperscale and cloud operators, colocation providers, data center OEMs and integrators, and the engineering and construction partners who specify and install liquid cooling infrastructure.
This is a highly visible role and a critical member of the Boyd Thermal leadership team. The successful candidate will be a thought leader who provides key observations and ideas, identifies risks and opportunities early, and is comfortable operating hands-on with customers, engineering teams, and manufacturing sites across multiple regions. Scaling a business from hundreds of millions to more than $1B is fundamentally a question of capacity, commitment, and disciplined commercial execution - this leader will be measured on all three, and on building the sales organization, processes, and customer relationships that make the next $1B repeatable rather than opportunistic.

Essential Responsibilities
Revenue Ownership and Commercial Strategy

• Own the global CDU revenue plan, developing and executing the sales strategy that carries the business past $1B and establishes the base for the year after.

• Convert the segment strategic plan into an actionable commercial operating plan by region, customer, and platform, with clear ownership, measures, and review cadence.

• Build the multi-year pipeline across hyperscale, colocation, enterprise, and OEM channels, and sequence design wins against qualification timelines and capacity availability.

• Protect gross margin through disciplined quoting, re-pricing, price increase execution, commercial claim recovery, and working capital improvement.

Customer and Partner Relationships

• Build and sustain executive-level relationships with hyperscale and colocation operators, data center OEMs, integrators, and the engineering and construction firms that specify liquid cooling infrastructure.

• Negotiate long-term agreements, capacity commitments, and healthy commercial terms that secure volume without ceding pricing power or exposing the business to unbalanced risk.

• Identify and pursue new business opportunities, including adjacent applications, new geographies, and channel models that extend the CDU platform beyond its current footprint.

• Lead strategic alliances and partnerships - including chip, server, and rack ecosystem partners - that accelerate market development and position Boyd early in customer reference designs.

title: WEG-Verwalter (m/f/d)

Dafür übernehmen wir Hausverwaltungen in ganz Deutschland und bauen sie zu Technologieunternehmen um. In den letzten drei Jahren sind wir so zu Deutschlands zweitgrößtem Immobilienverwalter geworden.

ÜBER DIE ROLLE

Bei Buena läuft die Hausverwaltung anders: Kein unnötiger Papierkram, keine veralteten Insellösungen. Du arbeitest direkt in unserer eigenen Buena-Software, die deinen Verwaltungsalltag digitalisiert, vereinfacht und spürbar beschleunigt. Auf dieser modernen Basis übernimmst du die eigenständige Betreuung eines festen Portfolios an WEG-Objekten. Du kennst das WEG-Recht im Detail und weißt, worauf es in der Praxis ankommt: Du führst Eigentümerversammlungen souverän durch, behältst auch bei komplexen Beschlüssen stets den Überblick und bringst durch unsere Technologie echte Transparenz und Effizienz in die Verwaltung.

VERANTWORTLICHKEITEN

- Du betreust dein WEG-Portfolio vollumfänglich und eigenverantwortlich - komplett digital über unsere Buena-Software.

- Du bereitest Eigentümerversammlungen vor, leitest sie rechtssicher sowie selbstständig und setzt die gefassten Beschlüsse konsequent um.

- Du bist der zentrale Ansprechpartner für Eigentümer, Beiräte, Dienstleister und Behörden.

- Du bringst deine Erfahrungen aus dem Verwaltungsalltag direkt in unser Product-Team ein: Dein Feedback aus der Praxis macht unsere Software jeden Tag besser.

- Du steuerst Instandhaltungs- und Sanierungsmaßnahmen digital und in transparenter Abstimmung mit allen Beteiligten.

DU PASST GUT, WENN DU

- Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung zum Immobilienkaufmann (m/w/d) oder ein Studium der Immobilienwirtschaft mitbringst.

- Eine Zertifizierung zum Verwalter (z. B. nach § 26a WEG) besitzt.

- Mindestens 3 Jahre praktische Erfahrung in der WEG-Verwaltung vorweisen kannst und das Tagesgeschäft sicher beherrschst.

- Bereits zahlreiche Eigentümerversammlungen selbstständig und souverän geleitet hast.

- Klar kommunizierst, verhandlungsstark bist und empathisch mit unterschiedlichen Eigentümerinteressen umgehen kannst.

- Tech-affin bist und keine Lust mehr auf veraltete Systeme, Ordnerstrukturen und Zettelwirtschaft hast.

- Fließend Deutsch sprichst (in Wort und Schrift).

DEINE BENEFITS

- Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Option auf Homeoffice.

- Sehr attraktive Vergütung mit Entwicklungsperspektive.

- 30 Urlaubstage für echte Erholung.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Foundational Storage
salary: $190K – $400K • Offers Equity • Plus up to 10% bonus
description:
ABOUT SENTRY

Software runs the world and the pace is faster than ever. Sentry helps developers fix errors and performance issues before users notice, so teams can spend less time firefighting and more time building.

Trusted by 200,000+ organizations, Sentry is today’s application monitoring standard and our team is building its AI-native future.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Sentry’s Foundational Storage team builds and supports the stateful storage systems that all our products rely on: object storage, relational databases, key-value stores, and caches. We help Sentry engineers store and access data consistently, durably, securely, and efficiently as our products and traffic grow.

We develop storage services like our open-source Objectstore https://github.com/getsentry/objectstore and build libraries and APIs that make existing storage systems easier to use. In our own services, we design storage protocols that keep data consistent across backends, even through concurrent updates and failures. Our abstractions let other engineering teams use storage without worrying about which cluster or instance holds their data.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the team, you’ll work on both the systems and the code that makes them easy to use. You’ll tackle questions of data consistency, availability, performance, and cost-efficiency, and work with product teams to turn their needs into practical solutions. The goal is simple: make the right way to store data the easy and obvious way.

IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL

- Design and operate storage systems used across Sentry, including their configuration and performance tuning.

- Create APIs and abstractions that make storage easy for product teams to use, with best practices for correctness, security, and scale built in.

- Solve storage challenges at scale, including consistency under concurrent access, sharding and rebalancing, and routing reads and writes across storage backends as workloads grow.

- Work with product engineers to choose storage approaches, plan safe migrations, and help teams adopt the tools you build.

- Plan and build with other Platform and Infrastructure teams, including analytical storage and streaming, to deliver a complete, fault-tolerant platform for product teams. Align roadmaps and standards, and design for failures and recovery.

- Improve storage performance and cost efficiency by making better use of backends and resources, while keeping the platform simple for product teams.

- Write code primarily in Rust and Python, with clear user-facing documentation. Develop advanced testing scenarios, such as production-scale chaos tests covering backend and infrastructure outages.

- Own latency and availability SLOs for your services, improve monitoring and incident response, and participate in the team’s on-call rotation.

YOU’LL LOVE THIS JOB IF YOU

- Enjoy digging into the internals of storage systems and understanding how they behave when traffic grows, requests race, or a dependency has a bad day.

- Care about a useful, easy-to-use API as much as what happens behind it.

- Like working with other engineers to understand their needs and make their day-to-day work easier.

- Want to follow your work from design and code through rollout and production for millions of developers.

- Want open-source contributions to be at the center of your day job.

QUALIFICATIONS

- 5+ years of software engineering experience building and operating distributed, stateful systems in production.

- Hands-on experience with object storage, relational databases, and caching systems at production scale. Experience with key-value or wide-column stores is a plus.

- An understanding of distributed systems fundamentals, including consistency, concurrency, and what happens when requests fail or need to be retried.

- Proficiency in a systems language such as Go, C++, Java, or Rust, and comfort working in Python. We primarily use Rust and Python, and welcome engineers who are new to Rust.

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike. We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can't wait to meet you.

Location Requirement

Candidates must reside in an eligible U.S. state throughout employment. We are unable to hire candidates residing in California, Alaska, Hawaii, U.S. territories, or outside the United States.

About the Role

The Strategic Operations team sits between Product, Technology, and Claims Operations. This role owns the function that turns a shipped feature, or a redesigned process, into a change the organization actually runs on.

We build most of our own technology, and the pace at which it reaches adjusters, managers, and customer-facing teams is picking up as the company scales. Each release and each process change alters how work is completed at Reserv . We are hiring an Operations Principal to own the function that makes those changes land: the standard every change meets before go-live, the sequencing of changes across teams, the readiness work, and the measurement that shows adoption happened.

You will lead two Operations Leads. One owns product launches and adoption: readiness, pilots, training, and whether the technology we ship gets used. The other owns process design and change: how work is designed, documented, and changed across claims operations, with or without a product release behind it. They run the work. You set the standard they run it to, decide how much of it a given change needs, arbitrate when their runways collide on the same teams, and hold the relationships with Product, Data, Learning & Development, and claims leadership. You will build the function into one that runs systematically. You will be an excellent fit if you have built or led a small team, have run cross-functional change at scale, hold dates when it's uncomfortable to, and can write for an executive audience without losing the detail.

Duties & Responsibilities

Change Management Framework and Governance: Own the standard every product launch and process change must meet before go-live, and the governance around it: who signs off, what evidence is required, and how much of the standard a given change needs. Keep the framework, its documentation, and the change history current, and decide when the framework itself has to change. Apply AI tools to how the function runs, from drafting change plans to tracking adoption.

Function Design and Operating Cadence: Build the function so it operates systematically: the intake path by which new launches and changes reach the team, the operating cadence between your Leads and their counterparts in Product, Data, and L&D, and the templates and playbooks each change runs on. The measure of success is a function that produces consistent launches.

Adoption Accountability and Feedback Loops: Be accountable for whether adoption happens across the company, not launch by launch. Set the adoption and failure metrics every change must define before go-live, own the regular usage report that reaches team leads, managers, and directors, and own the standing channels that carry field feedback back to Product: panels, pilot debriefs, the issue-reporting workflow, and a regular readout on what the next change should do differently.

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

Reporting into our UK People Operations Team Manager, you’ll work on all things HR and be responsible for supporting employees across the business and helping to make Trainline a great place to work. - Work with People Business Partners to support cyclical People processes and document and implement employee lifecycle changes, including personal and contractual updates.

- Support the preparation, validation, and processing of the monthly UK payroll, ensuring accurate and timely data inputs and alignment between HiBob and payroll workflows.

- Deliver day-to-day benefits administration, managing enrolments and changes accurately and resolving benefit-related issues efficiently.

- Manage employee lifecycle administration, including pre-boarding, contracts, background checks, Right to Work documentation, and visa sponsorship, ensuring employee data is accurate across systems and workflows.

- Process People-related invoices and purchase orders accurately, partnering with accounts payable and supporting effective financial administration.

- Support and manage the improvement, implementation, and documentation of People policies, processes, and templates, ensuring they remain up to date, user-friendly, and aligned with a tech-first, self-service culture.

And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

title: Head of Trust & Safety
description:

• Own student-facing safety specifically: age-appropriate content, self-harm and crisis handling, and escalation paths to educators.

• Has made safety a velocity enabler, not friction - builds guardrails as infrastructure so teams ship faster with confidence.

• Comfortable being the external face of safety at conferences, with press, and in front of district boards.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

• Hands-on experience with LLM safety tooling: evals, classifiers, and red-teaming.

• Experience handling live incidents involving minors or vulnerable users.

• Track record of building safety as product infrastructure, not a gate.

• Demonstrated ability to communicate safety tradeoffs clearly to executive and district-level audiences.

Your ImpactThe Vice President of Customer Success & Enablement leads DISCO 's Customer Success organization, setting the strategy, programs, standards, and operating cadence for how the team drives client value and consumption growth. They manage the CS leadership team and, through them, the broader CSM organization to oversee account planning, performance management, and professional development across the team. They also own the enablement function which includes client training, playbooks, and adoption programs. They must partner closely with Sales, Product, Marketing, and Finance to ensure Customer Success operates as a reliable, high-performing part of the company's go-to-market organization.
What You'll Do

• Drive Customer Value Realization: Builds and scales department-wide programs that help clients realize the full value of DISCO through proactive engagement, driving the adoption of strategic product capabilities, and other value-driving initiatives tailored to each account. Own the frameworks, playbooks, and execution standards to deliver these items. Report consistently to executive leadership and use the department’s KPIs to guide priorities, resourcing decisions, and performance management.

• Lead the Client Advisory Board: Partners with Marketing and Product to lead the Client Advisory Board, developing content and a strategy to simultaneously drive business objectives and deliver a genuinely high-value participant experience.

• Own CS Technology & AI Strategy: Sets and executes the department's technology strategy, with a focus on using technology and AI to drive efficiency without degrading the quality of the client experience. Defines adoption standards across the team and holds the department accountable to measurable ROI on its technology investments.

• Evolve Client Enablement Programs: Drives continuous evolution of the Enablement function, including new client-facing programs and training strategies that help customers understand how to use DISCO 's products and realize full value from AI features. Ensures enablement content and delivery keep pace with new product releases and evolving client needs.

• Cross-Functional GTM Point of Contact: Represents Customer Success for client-impacting and go-to-market initiatives spanning Marketing, Sales, Product, and Professional Services. Acts as a genuine strategic partner in cross-functional planning and decision-making, ensuring client context and CS's perspective shape outcomes rather than simply executing decisions made elsewhere.

Who You Are

• 7+ years of total Customer Success or related experience (account management, customer-facing SaaS roles)

• 5+ years of people management experience

• 2+ years of experience managing managers and directors

• Consumption-based revenue models:Fluency in how usage/consumption-based (vs. subscription/renewal-based) revenue works, including how to build and interpret metrics that isolate a CS organization's contribution to growth absent a traditional renewal base.

• B2B SaaS or legal technology domain experience: Prior experience in legal technology, eDiscovery, or another complex B2B SaaS environment serving sophisticated, expert-user clients (e.g., attorneys, technical buyers) is strongly preferred.

• CS platform and data fluency: Working knowledge of modern CS platforms (e.g., Planhat or equivalent), including health scoring, playbook/CTA automation, and using platform data to drive account strategy and reporting.

• People leadership and performance management: Demonstrated ability to coach managers of managers, build accountability-driven (not purely advocacy-driven) performance cultures, and make difficult talent decisions with courage and fairness.

• AI and emerging technology adoption: Familiarity with applying AI-driven capabilities within a CS motion (both internally, for efficiency, and externally, for client-facing product adoption.

Even Better If You Have…

• Experience in the legal technology marke

title: Commercial Counsel
description:
Exterro is seeking a proactive and resourceful Commercial Counsel to join our growing legal team. This is a remote-first position. Starting out, much of your time will be spent managing a broad portfolio of commercial, vendor, partner, and consulting contracts, with the remaining time dedicated to building skills across privacy, compliance, product counseling, and other areas. This role demands a deep understanding of technology and SaaS contracts, the ability to engage with stakeholders across the business, and the instinct to anticipate legal issues and develop proactive solutions before they become problems. This is a ground-floor opportunity for a lawyer who wants to grow into a senior in-house leader, with a clear path to expand your scope as you develop.

Reporting to the General Counsel, you will work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Security, Compliance, and Product teams to mitigate legal risk while facilitating revenue growth and operational efficiency. The ideal candidate possesses a strong background in technology transactions (specifically SaaS), a genuine enthusiasm for AI and emerging legal technology tools, excellent communication skills, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, international environment.

Key Responsibilities

Contract Negotiation & Drafting

• Draft, review, and negotiate SaaS subscription agreements, enterprise license agreements, order forms, partner and reseller agreements, SOWs, and amendments.

• Negotiate customer and vendor contracts, including MSAs, DPAs, BAAs, NDAs, and professional services agreements.

• Develop and maintain contract templates, playbooks, and clause libraries to improve speed and consistency.

• Partner with Sales and Customer Success to close deals efficiently while managing risk.

Risk Management & Compliance

• As you grow in the role, take on increasing responsibility across privacy and data protection (GDPR, CCPA/CPRA), product counseling, compliance, commercial dispute resolution, and marketing with go-to-market support.

• Assist with global privacy compliance initiatives (GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, emerging U.S. state privacy laws, and AI regulations such as the EU AI Act).

• Assist with dispute resolutions. Provide guidance on contract interpretations, operational compliance, and pre-litigation commercial disputes.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & General Support

• Act as a strategic legal partner to internal business teams, providing timely, practical legal advice that moves deals and projects forward.

• Collaborate with IT/Security, Compliance, and Finance teams to ensure commercial and vendor agreements align with corporate risk tolerances and budget requirements.

• Conduct legal research and stay current on legislation, regulatory developments, and case law affecting privacy, data protection, cybersecurity, AI regulation, open source licensing, and SaaS industry contracting practices.

• Collaborate with external legal counsel when necessary.

• Develop and implement internal policies and procedures to manage the company's legal and operational risk.

• Provide training and guidance to internal teams on legal topics relevant to Exterro 's business, including contract processes, data privacy, and compliance requirements.

• Support incident response efforts, including data breach notification obligations and coordination with Security and Compliance teams.

Qualifications & Experience

Required Education & Credentials

• Juris Doctor (J.D.) degree from an accredited law school.

• Active member in good standing of at least one State Bar.

Experience

• 3-6 years of experience practicing law, with a primary focus on commercial contracts and technology transactions.

• Proven experience in a corporate in-house legal department or a law firm tech/commercial practice group.

• Deep familiarity with SaaS business models, software licensing, and cloud computing legal issues.

title: Arabic Video Recording - Saudi Arabia
description:
What if your knowledge of Arabic language could help improve AI.
WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Record a single 15-20 second video in your native Arabic dialect.

• Speak naturally (no script). Suggested prompts: briefly introduce yourself, mention where you live, or talk about an interest/hobby.

Recording specifications (must meet all to be accepted)

• Video quality: 1080p or higher

• Length: 15-20 seconds

• Framing: Head-and-shoulders, face centered and fully visible

• Lighting/background: Well-lit face (no harsh shadows), plain/neutral background

• Expression: Neutral/relaxed while speaking naturally

• Audio: Clear speech, no background noise, music, or echo

• Orientation: Portrait or landscape acceptable (hold steady, no shaky footage)

• Environment: Quiet indoor setting preferred

• Prohibited: Filters/beauty modes, sunglasses, hats/hoods, face coverings, headphones/earbuds, watermarks, stickers, borders, other people/pets in frame
YOU ARE A FIT IF YOU'RE

description:
AST SpaceMobile is building the first and only global cellular broadband network in space to operate directly with standard, unmodified mobile devices based on our extensive IP and patent portfolio and designed for both commercial and government applications. Our engineers and space scientists are on a mission to eliminate the connectivity gaps faced by today’s five billion mobile subscribers and finally bring broadband to the billions who remain unconnected.

Position Overview

The Front Desk Security Officer is responsible for executing daily physical security operations at primary facility entry points within an aerospace manufacturing environment. This role focuses on controlling ingress and egress, enforcing access governance, protecting export-controlled and IP-sensitive areas, and ensuring the safety of employees, visitors, and high-value assets including prototypes and flight hardware.

The position serves as the first line of defense for facility security and operates in close coordination with Corporate Security, EH&S, Facilities, HR, IT, and Program Leadership to maintain controlled access, regulatory compliance, and life safety standards.

Base Pay: DOE

• This position is assigned to Friday, Saturday, Sunday 6pm to 6am

• The location will be at one of our four facilities located between Odessa and Midland.

What You'll Do:

Front Desk & Access Control Operations

• Monitor and control primary entry points to manufacturing, R&D, test, and corporate facilities.

• Verify identity and credentials of employees, contractors, visitors, customers, and vendors prior to granting access.

• Enforce badge policies, escort requirements, and visitor management procedures.

• Issue and collect temporary badges in accordance with security protocols.

• Maintain accurate visitor logs and access records.

• Monitor CCTV feeds and access control systems for unauthorized activity.

• Immediately escalate suspicious behavior, policy violations, or access anomalies to Corporate Security leadership.

Ingress and Egress Enforcement

• Ensure all individuals entering restricted or program-controlled areas have proper authorization.

• Enforce zoning, tiered access, and export-controlled area restrictions.

• Support onboarding and deprovisioning processes by verifying badge activation and deactivation status.

• Prevent tailgating and unauthorized piggybacking at controlled entry points.

• Conduct routine badge and credential audits at entry locations.

Intellectual Property (IP) and Asset Protection

• Support physical safeguards protecting export-controlled technologies, proprietary designs, trade secrets, prototypes, tooling, and flight hardware.

• Enforce policies related to secure material handling and restricted area access.

• Monitor movement of sensitive materials entering or leaving the facility in accordance with established procedures.

• Immediately report suspected unauthorized photography, recording, or removal of sensitive materials.

Incident Response Support

• Serve as the initial response point for security-related incidents at facility entry points.

• Initiate lockdown procedures when directed by Security or during emergency situations.

• Support evacuation and shelter-in-place procedures while maintaining accountability of restricted areas.

• Preserve incident documentation, visitor logs, and badge data to support investigations.

• Coordinate with EH&S and Corporate Security during emergencies affecting life safety or controlled spaces.

Compliance and Documentation

• Maintain strict adherence to ITAR/EAR and export-controlled area requirements.

• Complete daily activity logs, incident reports, and shift turnover documentation.

• Participate in security audits and inspections as required.

THE CARWOW GROUP

Carwow Group is driven by a passion for getting people into cars. But not just any car, the right car. That’s why we are building the go-to destination for car-changing, whether you are looking to buy, sell or lease. Designed to reach drivers everywhere with our trail-blazing portfolio of personality rich automotive brands; Carwow, Auto Express, evo, Driving Electric and Car Buyer.

What started as a simple reviews site, is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service. Over 10m customers have used Carwow to help them buy and sell cars since its inception.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia, doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with over 1.1 billion annual views, sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

WHY JOIN US?

We are winners of the prestigious Culture 100 award that recognises the most loved and happiest tech companies to work for! We have just raised $52m in funding led by global venture capital firm Bessemer Venture Partners (an early backer of LinkedIn and Shopify) to accelerate our growth plans!

As pioneers, we’re always driving for new territory and positive change, so our work as a group is never done. Where others see difficulty, it’s our responsibility to see possibility - building new experiences, launching new titles and listening to drivers.

Being a part of Carwow Group means championing drivers and the automotive industry, acting as a disrupter and never being afraid to fail (but learning fast when we do!).

The commercial team is around 60 people today, working alongside around 100 in operations, and we plan to scale our commercial operation significantly next year. You'll start with a small team and a clear mandate to build the function the business needs, making the case for investment with the VP's support. There's real room to grow, for the team and for you.

You report to the VP, Marketplace Operations, and you're accountable for the commercial forecast, the sales process and the Salesforce roadmap. The commercial teams own the selling and the relationships and the tech org builds and runs the platform; you work closely with all of them. After a year, success looks like a forecast the business trusts and trades on, one Salesforce and one process across both products, and a clear read of where deals are lost so enablement aims at the right things.

title: Freelance Corporate Facilitator — Leadership & Management
description:
Marcus Evans is a global leader in business intelligence, helping our clients grow by making connections, sharing knowledge, inspiring people, building relationships and creating new opportunities. With over four decades of experience and teams of highly experienced professionals across 50+ office locations, we deliver impactful strategic insight and business development guidance across all sectors through high-level summits, conferences, online platforms, performance coaching, and curated corporate event programmes. Based in 30+ countries, we create services that connect decision-makers, spark innovation, and drive real business growth.
ME Perform is the performance improvement consultancy of the Marcus Evans Group. We work differently from most of the training market: we diagnose what is actually holding an organisation's people back, design a programme specifically for them, deliver it over months rather than days, and measure whether behaviour genuinely changed, then hand the client written evidence of what improved. Because the design work is done in-house by our Programme Scientists, our trainers get something rare: a fully built, properly researched session, briefed to them in advance, delivered to a cohort who have already been diagnosed and who are expecting to work rather than watch.
Job Summary
You will deliver live sessions, typically 90 to 150 minutes, mostly online, working from a session design and a written brief prepared for you by the Programme Scientist.
This is a delivery role, and deliberately so. You are not asked to write content, find clients, or sell anything. You are asked to be outstanding in the room. Based on the seniority and ability of the applicant there will also be an opportunity extend this role to a follow-up coach with the same group.
Key Responsibilities

• Deliver live sessions to our designed structure, to a consistently high standard.

• Prepare from the written brief you receive at least five working days before each session - preparation time is paid within the session fee.

• Run structured practice: our sessions are built around participants doing the thing, not listening to it explained. Expect to spend much of each session facilitating small-group work, giving feedback, and coaching in the moment.

• Manage the room - including the sceptical senior participant, the quiet group, and the one who wants to debate rather than practise.

• Submit brief written session notes within 48 hours of every session, so the Programme Scientist can adjust what comes next.

• Take part in accreditation before your first client session, and stay open to observation and feedback afterwards.

Qualifications
Essential

• 5-10 years of substantial experience in facilitating live learning or development sessions for professional or managerial audiences in a corporate setting.

• Genuinely strong online delivery - confident running breakout groups, keeping cameras on and energy up, and handling the mechanics without it disrupting the session.

• Comfortable delivering material you did not write, to a structure you are asked to keep to. This is the single most important requirement of the role.

• Skilled at running practice and giving direct, useful feedback to adults - rather than presenting.

• Reliable on the administrative side: punctual, responsive, and consistent with session notes.

• Fluent, credible professional English, and comfortable with senior audiences.

Desirable

• Experience in one or more of: leadership and management development, communication and influence, collaboration, resilience and change, or working across cultures.

• A coaching qualification, or experience delivering one-to-one as well as group work.

• Additional languages, or experience delivering to international cohorts working in a second language.

• Familiarity with evidence-based learning design - you do not need to be a researcher, but you should be interested in why a session is built the way it is.

title: Senior Staff Data Engineer
description:
WHO ARE WE?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

WHY THIS ROLE?

We’re building the foundational infrastructure that will define how the world thinks about and deploys AI, and we want the sharpest, most driven, and most curious people to help us do it. As the head of the Data Foundation pillar of our Analytics and Data Insights team, you’ll lead the team that makes Cohere’s data trustworthy, governed, and available: the warehouse every analytics surface runs on, the pipelines that keep it fresh, the access model that keeps it secure, and the agentic analytics layer that lets anyone at Cohere (and their agents) ask questions of governed data directly.

Your team owns the full data lifecycle. You’ll run ingestion into BigQuery from internal and external data sources, orchestrate it in Airflow and Cloud Run, model the data warehouse in dbt, and serve the results through Looker, export APIs, and customer-facing analytics surfaces. Everything is provisioned as code in Terraform, and governance is part of the design: VPC service controls, IAM patterns, and documented access paths that let people and agents move fast without putting data at risk.

This role is both highly visible and highly impactful, and you’ll inherit a solid structure on which to build the rest of the stack: a Terraform-provisioned warehouse framework, dbt modeling conventions, an alerting and incident-response practice, and documentation patterns to keep everything discoverable. The roadmap is set with big bets in flight: scaling that framework across the company, standing up an internal analytics agent with a real eval harness, and consolidating institutional knowledge into a self-correcting and self-maintaining system that keeps context centralized, current, and documented, rather than dispersed and in people’s heads.

Responsibilities

As the head of the Data Foundation pillar, you will:

- Build and lead the team. Hire and grow a team of data and infrastructure engineers; set the technical bar; develop strong talent and raise team performance, building leadership capability beneath you.

- Set the roadmap from company strategy. Own and sequence the Data Foundation roadmap: the warehouse buildout, the agentic analytics program, data governance, and the platform work that unblocks our other pillars. You’ll make the trade-offs and carry the cross-functional impact that comes with them.

- Own the data platform end to end. Ingestion (managed connectors and an open-source connector framework), orchestration on Airflow and Cloud Run, warehouse modeling in BigQuery with dbt (raw, core, mart layers), and serving through Looker, export APIs, and semantic layers. All of it provisioned as code in Terraform.

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth , we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.
